questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of Separable Equations?
questions.answer: A separable first-order ODE can be rearranged so all dependent-variable factors are on one side and all independent-variable factors are on the other. It is the standard method for cooling, exponential growth, decay, and simple drag models.

questions.prompt: Solve dT/dt equals negative k times T minus T_s, where T_s is constant.
questions.answer: Move the temperature factor to the left: \[\frac{dT}{T-T_s}=-k\,dt\] Integrate both sides: \[\int\frac{1}{T-T_s}\,dT=\int-k\,dt\] so \[\ln|T-T_s|=-kt+C\] Exponentiate: \[T-T_s=Ae^{-kt}\] Therefore \[T(t)=T_s+Ae^{-kt}\]

questions.prompt: Solve dP/dt equals rP with P(0)=P_0.
questions.answer: Separate variables: \[\frac{dP}{P}=r\,dt\] Integrate: \[\ln P=rt+C\] Exponentiate: \[P=Ae^{rt}\] Apply P(0)=P_0: \[P_0=A\] Thus \[P(t)=P_0e^{rt}\]
